correctness.rationale: Explicit halfspace descriptions identify all fourteen facets and their vertices for both combinatorial regimes. Central section vertex number is the number of sign-changing facets for generic normals. The derived minima and maxima on each facet yield the three-indicator formulas; strictly feasible parameter-uniform normal triples certify all counts. Exact edge inventories of types 24+12 and 12+24, together with spherical angular sign-separation, give the Haar mean. Algebraic derivatives strictly increase then decrease, with equality only at rectification. An independent exact edge checker matched 21,151 generic rational/integer instances; six Gaussian computations corroborated expectations, but neither replaces the proof.

value.rationale: A complete natural geometry classification for a continuum of fourteen-facet centrally symmetric polytopes: all generic normal chambers, exact attainable polygon-size support with positive-probability witnesses, a unique all-octagon rectification, and a sharp strict extremum of the Haar-averaged section size. It directly advances the section-vertex function viewpoint of recent combinatorial slicing research and supplies a substantive structural transition rather than a routine isolated numerical exercise.
